base_dir.description: Root directory where build artifacts, logs, and state are stored.

log_dir.description: Directory for log files. If left blank, defaults to base_dir/logs.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent builds allowed.

bind_address.description: IP address the daemon binds to for its HTTP API and web UI.

bind_port.description: Port the daemon listens on for HTTP(S) requests.

use_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the web UI and API.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (only used if use_ssl=true).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (only used if use_ssl=true).

build_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for a single build before timeout.

min_free_disk_mb.description: Minimum free disk space (MB) required to accept new builds.

apt_sources_url.description: Base URL template for Debian APT sources (supports {distro}, {suite}, {arch} placeholders).

extra_apt_keys.description: List of paths to extra APT GPG keys (space-separated in rendered config).

distributions.description: List of supported distributions to build for. Each entry defines name, suites, and architectures.

builders.description: List of remote or local builders to use for builds.

host.description: Hostname or IP of builder (use 'localhost' for local builder).

ssh_key_file.description: Optional path to private SSH key file (if not default).

enabled.description: Whether this builder is enabled for new builds.

repo_sign_key_fingerprint.description: Full fingerprint (space-separated hex) of the key to sign the local APT repository. Leave empty to skip signing.

repo_distribution.description: Distribution name used in the generated APT repository (e.g., 'stable', 'unstable').

enable_auth.description: Enable HTTP Basic Authentication for the web UI and API.

auth_users_file.description: Path to file containing htpasswd-formatted user credentials (only used if enable_auth=true).
